chapter.verse: Thukham a thei ute naute aw, mi khat a nuntak lai takin thukham in tua mi a uk hi cih thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, pasal a nei numei in a pasal a sih matengin thukham bangin a pasal tawh a kikhih khawm hi. A pasal a sih leh, numei in a pasal’ thukham tawh a kipelh hi.

Tua ahih ciangin a pasal a nuntak lai-in midang’ zi a suah leh, numei gilo a kici ding hi. Ahih hangin a pasal a sih leh, tua numei in thukham tawh a kipelhkhia a, midang tawh a kiteeng zongin numei gilo a kici kei ding hi.

Tua mah bangin ka ute ka naute aw, note in zong midang a kici sihna pan a thokik mi’ zi na hi uh a, Pasian’ deihna bangin gah na gah nadingun Khazih’ pumpi hangin na si uh a, Thukham tawh na kikhen uh hi.
Eite in i pumpi ngeina bangin gamta-in i om lai takin, mawhna tawh akipawl i lungsim in Thukham hangin piang a, sihna suahna gah a gah nadingin i pumpi tung nate sungah nasem hi.
Tu-in ahih leh, thukham lui muang loin, Kha Siangtho’ nuntakna thak sungah na i sep nadingin hong ukpa lamah i sih khit ciangin thukham pan i suakta zo hi.

Tua bang ahih leh, bang i ci gen ding hiam? Thukham in mawhna ahi i ci ding hiam? Tua bang hi zenzen lo hi. Ahi zongin thukham bek hangin mawhna lungsim ka thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, “Huaihamna lungsim nei kei in,” ci-in Thukham in na ci kei leh, huaihamna lungsim ke’n ka thei kei ding hi.
Ahih hangin mawhna thu in thukham hangah thu ngah ahih ciangin ka lungsim sungah huaihamna apawlpawl a piangsak hi. Thukham om kei leh, mawhna a si ding hi.
Nidang lai-inah thukham loin ka nungta hi. Ahih hangin thukham hong pian’ ciangin mawhna nungta kik a, kei ka si hi.
Hin’na tawh kipawl thukham in sihna tawh kipawl ahih lam keimah in ka thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mawhna in thukham hangin thu ngah a, thukhamna tawh hong kheemin hong that hi.
Tua hi a, Thukham in a siangtho hi. A thu in zong a siangtho, a dik, a pha hi.

Tua bang ahih leh, a hoih a pha na in keima tungah sihna a suak ahi hiam? Tua bang hi zenzen lo hi. Mawhna in mawhna taktak ahihna a kilat nadingin a pha nate hangin keima sungah sihna thu a piangsak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mawhna in thukham hangin mawhna taktak a pian’ theih nading ahi hi.
Thukham in Kha Siangtho tawh kipawl ci-in i thei hi. Keimah in mawhna khut sungah a kizuak, a si thei leitungmi ka hi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ka gamtatna ka thei kei hi. Ka gamtat nop bangin ka gamta kei hi. Ka muhdah gamtatna ka hih hi.
Ahih hangin ka gamtat nop lohna ka gamtat leh, Thukham in a pha hi ka ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin gamtatna a hoih lo keimah in ka hih kei hi, keima sungah a om khialhna in a hih hi.
Ka sa ahi ka pum sungah a pha khat beek a om kei hi cih ka thei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, a pha gamtat nopna lungsim ka neih hangin a pha gamtat theih nading ka mu kei hi.
A pha ka gamtat nop ka hih thei kei hi. Ka gamtat nop loh gitlohna ka hih hi.
Ahih hangin gamtat nop loh na ka gamtat leh, keimah in ka gamta kei hi; ka sungah a om mawhna in a gamta hi.
Tua hi a, a hoih a gamta nuam keima sungah mawhna thu a om cih ka thei hi.
Ka sung mi hangin Pasian’ Thukham a pha ka sa hi.
Ahi zongin ka pum tung nate lakah adang thukham khat ka lungsim tawh kido a, ka pum tung nate mawhna khut sungah manin a piak theih ka mu hi.
Lunggim mi ka hi takpi hi! Hih a si ding pumpi panin kua in hong honkhia ding hiam?
Eite hong hon Topa Zeisu Khazih hangin Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat hi! Tua ahih ciangin ka lungsim hangin Pasian’ thukham deihna ka zuih hangin, ka pumpi hangin mawhna’ Thukham deihna ka zui hi.
